basis: Original full page and full-width source context viewed before proposed neutral crop rectangles. These textual obligations describe actual source notation, not candidate component bounds.

ordinarySeparationPages.upper: All whole-bar rests, the left clef and its lower dot/tail, and the full five-line staff. No musical stem connects this rest staff to the next one.
ordinarySeparationPages.lower: High ledger-line dyads and accidentals, all stems, the long upper slurs/ties across measures, the final right-reaching slur that touches the system boundary, the dolce instruction and clef tail. The final upper slur must remain even if analysis detaches it from the structural edge.

ordinarySeparationPages.upper: Every whole-bar rest and complete left treble clef/tail. The right-edge vertical line is structural, not a shared musical stem.
ordinarySeparationPages.lower: The entering high ledger dyads with short slur, ff below the entry, subsequent separated dyads and stems, and all final sharp accidentals/chords/stems. Both high ledger notes and low stem ends must be present.

ordinarySeparationPages.upper: Bass notes and rests, rising beamed entry, high half notes, all long upper slurs including the last slur reaching the right boundary, p and cresc./f marks, and complete left clef.
ordinarySeparationPages.lower: Bass notes and rests, the slurred three-note rising figure followed by beamed descending notes, lower cresc./f text, subsequent notes, and final full-bar rests.

unchangedScope: No instrument identities are assigned to these unresolved pages. Staff IDs are physical observed staves only. No source guard from a prior report is modified.
